notable.headline: Walmart Reports Q3 Performance and Raises Fiscal 2027 Outlook (11-17)
notable.read: This conflicts with the company-confirmed 11-19 date, and there is no 8-K 2.02 in the window. The source slug ('retail's $1.013 trillion holiday forecast meets its first earnings test') reads like a preview. I treat it as mis-summarized and the print as still ahead, which is an inference. If the PM or Market Analyst sees WMT trading as though results are out, that would contradict this read. It continues the 11-10 to 11-17 pre-print thread of crowded bullish PT drift.

notable.headline: UL Solutions Enters Definitive Agreement to Acquire Worldly (11-17)
notable.read: This explains the 8-K 7.01/8.01 filed 11-17 that I left open yesterday. It is a software tuck-in filed without item 1.01, so likely small. That closes the item.

notable.headline: 8-K 1.01/2.03/9.01 filed 11-17 (no headline)
notable.read: A material agreement with a direct financial obligation, the day after the Davis President/CFO promotion. Most likely a financing (inference). Only the filing text can say whether it is a credit facility or something larger.

notable.headline: Incyte Corporation Insider Sells Shares Worth $1.29 Million (11-17)
notable.read: A small insider sale on a held name, following the 11-13 MAESTRA-3 drop. It doesn't touch guidance or the thesis clauses. Treat it as sentiment only.

notable.headline: Senator Elizabeth Warren Calls for Breakup of Major Healthcare Conglomerates (11-18)
notable.read: Political risk added to the post-print drift (Argus, Wells Fargo, the Deutsche Bank downgrade, RBC since 11-10). No legislative or agency step is named, so it is a headline risk, not an event.

notable.headline: Apple Reportedly Nearing Long-Term DRAM Supply Agreement With Samsung (11-17)
notable.read: This bears on the 11-03 memory-cost margin warning thread: a multi-year supply lock from 2027 would address it. It is a report, not a signed deal. The 11-17/11-18 service outages are operational noise unless they persist.

notable.headline: 8-K 5.02 filed 11-10 aged out of the 7-day window
notable.read: Open since 11-11 and never explained by a headline. It closes by expiry, not by resolution, 3 trading days before the estimated 11-23 print. The same will happen to FTDR's 11-12 5.02 and SAM's 11-13 8.01 within two sessions.
